  - Quote: "PTO may be used for vacation, personal time, illness, or any other purpose. Employees must request PTO through the designated time-off system. Requests for three or more consecutive days require supervisor approval at least two weeks in advance." [Policy 50010 - Types of Leave: Paid Time Off (PTO)]
- Carryover and limits:
  - Quote: "Employees may carry over up to 40 hours of unused PTO to the following calendar year. Maximum PTO balance at any time is 240 hours. Accrual stops when the maximum balance is reached." [Policy 50010 - Types of Leave: Paid Time Off (PTO)]
- Separation:
  - Quote: "Employees who separate from employment in good standing will be paid for unused accrued PTO up to a maximum of 80 hours at their current rate of pay." [Policy 50010 - Types of Leave: Paid Time Off (PTO)]

  - Quote: "This policy applies to all regular part-time employees who work a minimum of 20 hours per week and have completed their probationary period." [Policy 50020 - Types of Leave: Paid Time Off (PTO) - Part-time]

  - Quote: "Part-time employees accrue PTO on a pro-rated basis calculated from their regularly scheduled hours.
